title: Darkness Descends
narrativeText: The arena goes dark. Not a flicker — total blackness. When the lights return, Daemon is already in the ring. The Extreme Championship is at stake. The opponent is not prepared for what comes next.

choices.label: Let the Darkness Win
choices.text: The championship belongs to the darkness.

title: Territorial
narrativeText: Daemon has claimed the entire backstage area as his domain. He stands at the locker room entrance and will not move. Catering, production, other wrestlers — all of them take the long way around. The champion comes through next. Daemon does not step aside.

choices.label: Take the Long Way
choices.text: This isn't the fight worth having tonight. You circle around.

choices.label: Stand Your Ground
choices.text: Your locker room. Your hallway. Your championship. Nobody moves you.
